page_title: Cuecaps: word-by-word captions and auto cuts for Shorts and TikTok

sources.entry: Cuecaps - Animated word-by-word captions for Shorts, TikTok and Reels, transcribed and rendered in the browser so the video never uploads; exports MP4, transparent overlays and SRT/VTT. #freemium

summary.name: Cuecaps
summary.one_liner: Cuecaps is a browser-based video studio that adds animated word-by-word captions and automatically cuts pauses, filler words and retakes from short-form videos for Shorts, TikTok and Reels.
use_cases: Adding animated word-by-word captions to a TikTok, Short or Reel
Cutting pauses, ums and retakes from a talking-head video
Exporting transparent caption overlays for Premiere Pro, Resolve or CapCut
Generating SRT or VTT subtitle files from a video
Exporting an EDL or FCPXML cut list to rebuild edits in another editor
Captioning a video without uploading it to a server
summary.what_it_does: Cuecaps transcribes a video either on the user's device (on-device, free and unlimited) or in the cloud (ElevenLabs Scribe v3, with minutes limits by plan). It shows captions animated word by word in selectable styles and exports an MP4, transparent MOV or WebM overlays, and SRT/VTT subtitle files. Fast edit removes dead space, filler words, stutters and retakes, adds jump-cut zoom, and normalizes volume to -14 LUFS. Previews and exports render in the browser, so source footage is not uploaded. The transcript can be downloaded as TXT, and captions can be translated using Chrome's built-in translator.
notable: Video is rendered in the browser and never uploaded; only compressed audio goes to cloud transcription
Transparent MOV and WebM overlays plus EDL and FCPXML cut lists for Premiere Pro, Resolve, Final Cut and CapCut
Fast edit automatically removes dead space, filler words, retakes and adds jump-cut zoom
MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop caption files
caveats: Free exports carry a 'Made with cuecaps.com' watermark; Fast edit export and cut lists need the paid Creator or Pro plan
Cloud transcription minutes are capped monthly (Free 10, Creator 1,000, Pro 3,000); cloud transcription pauses when the allowance runs out
Creator is $9 a month or $84 a year; Pro is $19 a month or $180 a year; 4K export is Pro only
Remove voices feature runs only in Chrome or Edge on a computer
